correctness.rationale: The standard Szegő-kernel identity and Schwarz–Pick establish near-one preimage localization; convexity forces the image to a line, and analytic continuation on each radial circle plus the harmonic maximum principle and open mapping theorem forces the ratio phi(z)/z to be constant. The limit at radius one forces this constant real, proving the if-and-only-if classification including boundary cases. Exact finite diagnostics verify supporting identities without replacing the analytic argument.
